prompt:
Replace the append-only analytics rollup with a revision-aware incremental ledger and migrate every source boundary. This monorepo has sixteen independently named wire schemas and 80+ source/config/test files. Implement the complete library, source adapters and checkpoint lifecycle, preserving the existing ingest API. Add regression tests; use only the standard library.

Contract:
* analytics.ledger.Ledger() exposes apply(events), totals(), checkpoint(), and classmethod restore(checkpoint). apply accepts a list of canonical event dictionaries with EXACT fields {'id': str, 'tenant': str, 'revision': int, 'day': str, 'value': int, 'deleted': bool}. id and tenant are nonempty. revision >= 1. bool is not an int. day is an actual ISO YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, and value is any signed integer. deleted=True requires value=0. Reject invalid shapes/values with ValueError and leave the entire ledger unchanged on ANY invalid event or conflict in a batch.
* Identity is (tenant,id). The highest revision wins, even if it moves day or deletes an event. Lower revisions are ignored after validation. An equal revision is a no-op only if all fields match; otherwise ValueError and rollback the whole batch. Events within a batch are processed in input order. Deleted events retain their revision for replay suppression. No references to caller-owned objects may be retained.
* totals() returns a list of {'tenant': str, 'day': str, 'value': int, 'count': int} sorted by (tenant,day). Include every bucket containing at least one nondeleted current event, even if its sum is zero; omit empty buckets. count counts current events, not revisions. Returned data must not alias internal state.
* checkpoint() returns {'version': 2, 'events': [canonical current events sorted by (tenant,id)]}. restore validates exact version/schema/event rules and rejects duplicate identities (even identical duplicates) with ValueError; it must not depend on input ordering and must own its input data. Checkpoint/restart must preserve deleted-event and stale-revision semantics.
* Each sources/<source>/schema.json specifies wire field names. Adapter.decode(raw) maps those fields to the exact canonical event, with missing revision default 1 and missing deleted default False; all other missing fields and malformed input raise ValueError. Each sources/<source>/service.py exports ingest(ledger, rows) returning ledger.totals() AFTER one atomic batch, plus preview(ledger, rows) returning the same projected totals WITHOUT mutating the supplied ledger, including when validation fails. Decode every row before applying; neither operation mutates rows. analytics.api.ingest(source,ledger,rows) and preview(source,ledger,rows) route all sixteen sources. Reject unknown source with ValueError. Cross-source events share identity when tenant/id match.
* Source field names and integration modules are part of the public API; retain every source and schema. Internal designs are unrestricted. The old tests exercise append-only positive events only; the actual contract includes corrections, cancellation, zero totals, tenant isolation, atomic conflicts and checkpoint recovery.
